bundle_policy.rationale: Bundled = clean PASS assemblies with at most max_sequence_records sequences, plus assemblies already in production through a reviewed intervention (hg19: one reviewed source-label correction). REVIEW, FAIL and NO_SOURCE assemblies are never imported automatically.
bundle_policy.canonical_id_rationale: canonical_id is the UCSC database id, except for the reviewed names in canonical_id_overrides. An override must equal, verbatim, the '(<name>/<db>)' token of the UCSC description of that database, so no name is invented and no prose is parsed. Descriptions whose token carries an institution or a version prefix (for example 'Broad CanFam3.1/canFam3' or 'BDGP Release 6 + ISO1 MT/dm6') or only an institution ('Broad/equCab2') are not overridden. hg19 stays hg19: UCSC's hg19 is GRCh37 with a different mitochondrial sequence (chrM), so the name GRCh37 would claim the wrong sequence set.

label_corrections.rationale: UCSC labels this alias 'genbank' but NC_ is the NCBI RefSeq accession prefix and NCBI nuccore reports NC_001807.4 as a RefSeq record (Homo sapiens mitochondrion, complete genome, 16571 bp, equal to hg19.chrom.sizes chrM). Only the authority label is corrected; the alias string and its association with chrM are unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

ensembl_evidence.match_rule: A top-level Ensembl region adds its name as the ensembl alias of the one hg19 record whose GenBank or RefSeq accession equals the region's INSDC or RefSeq_genomic synonym exactly (versioned). No name matching; assembly aliases are never copied; an accession contradiction, zero/multiple matches, or an explicit upstream ensembl alias is a build error.

ucsc_name_disagreements.rationale: Ensembl GRCh37 MT (16569 bp) is identified by RefSeq NC_012920.1, which in the hg19 table belongs to chrMT; Ensembl's own UCSC synonym 'chrM' names a different sequence in UCSC hg19 (chrM = NC_001807.4, 16571 bp). The accession decides identity; the UCSC-name synonym is not used.
